<!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>导出文字的分组、测量、换行与原生边界</title><style>body{max-width:1280px;margin:auto;padding:24px;background:#101a29;color:#e3edf8;font:15px/1.7 "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}a{color:#96d1ff}p,small{color:#b0c6dc}.notice{background:#1c2d43;border-left:4px solid #dfb16e;padding:15px}details{background:#17273c;padding:14px;border:1px solid #3f5671;margin:14px 0}summary{cursor:pointer}.unknown{border-color:#d299ac}.independent-implementation{border-color:#70bef5}pre{font:12px/1.6 Consolas,monospace;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;background:#0b1524;padding:12px}code{overflow-wrap:anywhere}</style><a href="index.html">← 架构索引</a> · <a href="image-export-entry-audit.html#E09">图像保存文字入口</a><h1>导出文字的分组、测量、换行与原生边界</h1><p class="notice">IMultiText→按Position分组→字号/测量/换行→PutTextZh→PInvoke。屏幕TextShape、原OpenCV导出与当前TextBlock/Runner分别列出；25个选定托管体与1个PInvoke声明，未执行厂商或native。闭合入口链数仍为0。</p><p><a href="export-text-rendering-audit.json">完整专题JSON</a> · <a href="export-text-rendering-audit.cil.json">独立CIL</a> · <a href="export-text-rendering-audit.decompile.json">工具与输出摘要</a></p><nav><a href="#T01">T01</a> · <a href="#T02">T02</a> · <a href="#T03">T03</a> · <a href="#T04">T04</a> · <a href="#T05">T05</a> · <a href="#T06">T06</a> · <a href="#T07">T07</a> · <a href="#T08">T08</a> · <a href="#T09">T09</a> · <a href="#T10">T10</a> · <a href="#T11">T11</a> · <a href="#T12">T12</a> · <a href="#C01">C01</a> · <a href="#U01">U01</a></nav><details id="T01" class="source-confirmed"><summary>T01 · 原Apps.Data引用与外部接口/包装程序集 → 有限静态身份和IText数据合同 · source-confirmed</summary><p>原Apps.Data的OpenCvSharp与VMControls.RenderInterface引用均为1.0.0.0；选定外部文件的名称、版本、公钥token相符，SHA/MVID/REA身份单列。IText继承IShapeBase，直接声明Content/Position/int FontSize；Stroke/Opacity来自IShapeBase。IMultiText继承IShape与IShapeBase，提供List&lt;IText&gt; Texts。接口没有导出字体族、文字宽高或换行属性。</p><p>待核：名称/版本/token匹配是静态候选关联，不证明原机CLR实际选中此路径；接口getter的运行值/副作用未执行。</p><details><summary>VMControls.RenderInterface.IText · 5–12</summary><p><code>docs/architecture-recovery/export-text-rendering-audit.resources/VMControls.RenderInterface.IText.decompiled.cs · original-managed-offline-ilspy-decompilation · SHA ee983275128f2ab388a7fdd58a588c235e5c8ad846cbfefb154e2fcd6ca2c86e</code></p><pre>public interface IText : IShapeBase
{
	string Content { get; }

	Point Position { get; }

	int FontSize { get; }
}</pre></details><details><summary>VMControls.RenderInterface.IShapeBase · 3–9</summary><p><code>docs/architecture-recovery/export-text-rendering-audit.resources/VMControls.RenderInterface.IShapeBase.decompiled.cs · original-managed-offline-ilspy-decompilation · SHA 93af1a94b0dff528a70c0ddfc8cd776742de3b2ec09d108e6efde353a2135e43</code></p><pre>public interface IShapeBase
{
	double Opacity { get; }

	string Stroke { get; }
}
</pre></details><details><summary>VMControls.RenderInterface.IMultiText · 5–8</summary><p><code>docs/architecture-recovery/export-text-rendering-audit.resources/VMControls.RenderInterface.IMultiText.decompiled.cs · original-managed-offline-ilspy-decompilation · SHA 97caed67086215487c05c3c4f93345edfcefa8033c747b315d66f4be6fab01b0</code></p><pre>public interface IMultiText : IShape, IShapeBase
{
	List&lt;IText&gt; Texts { get; }
}</pre></details></details><details id="T02" class="source-confirmed"><summary>T02 · DrawShape(IShape,Mat) → 透明度门→IMultiText→按Position分组快照 · source-confirmed</summary><p>shape.Opacity==0且非IMultiPoint时先返回，所以零透明IMultiText不进文本分支。IMultiText.Texts以GroupBy(p.Position).ToList形成位置组；原lambda只返回IText.Position。每组num从0开始；按该组枚举顺序调用DrawText，全部文本分组处理完直接return。此文本分支不读取各IText.Opacity，也不以非零multiText.Opacity给BGR颜色另乘透明度。</p><p>待核：本方法没有Texts或单项null保护；LINQ/自定义getter异常的实际输入未运行。单独IText不等于IMultiText，本专题不凭接口相近增加新分派。</p><details><summary>Apps.Data.Common.ImageSaveOpenCvHelper::DrawShape · 150–169</summary><p><code>docs/architecture-recovery/export-text-rendering-audit.cil.json · original-managed-cil · SHA f5376045271b37e36bbb4cb4eca5e92ff714a748ce11d0f6c8714539d82f4a5c</code></p><pre>          &quot;token&quot;: &quot;0x06000272&quot;,

              &quot;opcode&quot;: &quot;ldarg.0&quot;,</pre></details></details><details id="T10" class="source-confirmed"><summary>T10 · NativeMethods.core_putTextZh声明 → Cdecl/LPStr桥接，原生字体和栅格保持未知 · source-confirmed</summary><p>原包装中调用0x060017a9，原件方法标PinvokeImpl且无托管体。离线声明DllImport(OpenCvSharpExtern)，CallingConvention.Cdecl、ExactSpelling=true、BestFitMapping=false、ThrowOnUnmappableChar=true；text和font标LPStr；Point/Scalar按声明值参数，italic/underline在Cv2中转成0或1。主链显式字体覆盖Cv2默认Arial；不据PutTextZh名字推断UTF-8/Unicode协议或字体选择成功。三个已有native候选文件仅记SHA/PE machine，不证明实际DLL解析。</p><p>待核：LPStr在原机的有效编码、native实现/寄存器ABI、字体回退、字形布局、抗锯齿、裁切和真实加载路径未验证；不执行厂商native。</p><details><summary>OpenCvSharp.Cv2::PutTextZh · 10976–10995</summary><p><code>docs/architecture-recovery/export-text-rendering-audit.cil.json · original-managed-cil · SHA f5376045271b37e36bbb4cb4eca5e92ff714a748ce11d0f6c8714539d82f4a5c</code></p><pre>          &quot;token&quot;: &quot;0x060001ea&quot;,

	public static extern void core_putTextZh(IntPtr img, [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPStr)] string text, Point org, int fontScale, Scalar color, [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPStr)] string font, int italic, int underline);</pre></details></details><details id="T11" class="source-confirmed"><summary>T11 · 屏幕TextShape.AddMultiText → 屏幕绘制合同与OpenCV导出分列 · source-confirmed</summary><p>已取原屏幕TextShape使用SystemFonts.MessageFontFamily/Style/Weight，读取显示比例与ImageView尺寸比，可按ISize计算最大宽高字号，FormattedText.MaxTextWidth按图宽×ControlToImageRadio，坐标也乘比例并DrawingContext.DrawText。组间偏移用formattedText.Height/比例+0.5，最后Visual.Opacity=multiText.Opacity；导出链的宽1%字号、固定字体、首次整数行高、BGR及PutTextZh均另有规则。静态差异不是原机故障证明。</p><p>待核：不关闭全部屏幕文字分支、活模板/字体/像素一致性；本专题只用有限屏幕成员作边界对照。</p><details><summary>VMBaseControls.Base.ImageView.Shape.TextShape::AddMultiText · 17122–17141</summary><p><code>docs/architecture-recovery/rendering-layers-cil-evidence.json · original-managed-cil · SHA 7fabb24207ccff4a4f4b5f5cd4530f6db2638b70ddc21b447fd3922217513fe4</code></p><pre>          &quot;token&quot;: &quot;0x06000312&quot;,

            {
              &quot;offset&quot;: 0,
              &quot;label&quot;: &quot;IL_0000&quot;,
              &quot;opcode&quot;: &quot;nop&quot;,</pre></details><details><summary>screen AddMultiText · 15–80</summary><p><code>analysis/decompiled/VMBaseControls/VMBaseControls.Base.ImageView.Shape/TextShape.cs · local-decompiled-source · SHA 54ba19a70c8731fe25ebbd4a77ac81b3fc8a02385b00f4e846da68c0e493d0c2</code></p><pre>	public static int AddMultiText(IMultiText multiText, int ImageSourceWidth, int ImageSourceHeight, double ControlToImageRadio, ShapeCanvas container, ImageViewBox imageView)
	{
		int num = 0;
		if (multiText.Texts != null &amp;&amp; ImageSourceWidth != 0 &amp;&amp; ImageSourceHeight != 0)
		{
			double num2 = 1.0;
			if (imageView != null)
			{
				double num3 = Math.Min(imageView.ActualWidth, imageView.GetImageViewWidth());
				double num4 = Math.Min(imageView.ActualHeight, imageView.GetImageViewHeight());
				if (num3 &gt; 0.0 &amp;&amp; num4 &gt; 0.0)
				{
					num2 = num4 / num3;
				}
			}
			List&lt;IGrouping&lt;Point, IText&gt;&gt; list = (from p in multiText.Texts
				group p by p.Position).ToList();
			foreach (IGrouping&lt;Point, IText&gt; item in list)
			{
				DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
				double num5 = 0.0;
				using (DrawingContext drawingContext = drawingVisual.RenderOpen())
				{
					foreach (IText item2 in item)
					{
						IText text = item2;
						if (text.Position.X &gt; (double)(ImageSourceWidth * 3) || text.Position.Y + num5 &gt; (double)(ImageSourceHeight * 3))
						{
							break;
						}
						int num6 = text.FontSize;
						string content = text.Content;
						if (num6 &lt;= 0 || num6 &gt; 1000)
						{
							num6 = 10;
						}
						double fontSize = num6;
						if (num2 &gt; 1.0)
						{
							fontSize = (double)num6 * num2;
						}
						if (text is ISize { Width: not 0.0, Height: not 0.0 } size)
						{
							fontSize = Math.Min(CalculateMaxWidthFontSize(size.Width * ControlToImageRadio, num6, content, SystemFonts.MessageFontFamily, SystemFonts.MessageFontStyle, SystemFonts.MessageFontWeight, FontStretches.Normal), CalculateMaxHeightFontSize(size.Height * ControlToImageRadio, num6, content, SystemFonts.MessageFontFamily, SystemFonts.MessageFontStyle, SystemFonts.MessageFontWeight, FontStretches.Normal));
						}
						FormattedText formattedText = DrawShapeHelper.MeasureText(content, SystemFonts.MessageFontFamily, SystemFonts.MessageFontStyle, SystemFonts.MessageFontWeight, FontStretches.Normal, fontSize);
						formattedText.SetForegroundBrush(DrawShapeHelper.GetBrushByString(text.Stroke));
						formattedText.MaxTextWidth = (double)ImageSourceWidth * ControlToImageRadio;
						drawingContext.DrawText(formattedText, new Point(text.Position.X * ControlToImageRadio, (text.Position.Y + num5) * ControlToImageRadio));
						num5 = formattedText.Height / ControlToImageRadio + num5 + 0.5;
						num++;
					}
				}
				drawingVisual.Opacity = multiText.Opacity;
				container.AddVisual(drawingVisual, &quot;text&quot;);
			}
		}
		return num;
	}

	internal static double AddTextBlock(IShapeBase text, string content, Point pos, int fontSize, double addPos, int ImageSourceWidth, int ImageSourceHeight, double ControlToImageRadio, ShapeCanvas container, ImageViewBox imageView)
	{
		if (fontSize &lt;= 0 || fontSize &gt; 1000)

        {
            var text = new W.TextBlock { Name = &quot;DisplayOverlayText&quot;, Text = frame.Text, FontSize = frame.FontSize, Opacity = frame.Opacity,
                Foreground = (System.Windows.Media.Brush)new BrushConverter().ConvertFromInvariantString(frame.Color)! };
            W.Canvas.SetLeft(text, frame.PositionX); W.Canvas.SetTop(text, frame.PositionY); labels.Children.Add(text);
        }
        DrawGraphics();</pre></details><details><summary>current text graphic display · 80–86</summary><p><code>src/VisionPluginContracts/ToolDisplayPresenter.cs · current-source · SHA 0148527f597e5db2239b4efab3987ca992b2216317cd166a95f9f51f7238c6e2</code></p><pre>            if(graphic.Type==&quot;text&quot;){
                // FontSize zero is the source conversion fallback. Avoid an invalid
                // WPF FontSize assignment; original native zero-font rendering remains unverified.

                continue;

        int w=image.Width,h=image.Height; var rgb=new byte[checked(w*h*3)];
        for(int i=0;i&lt;image.Pixels.Length;i++) rgb[i*3]=rgb[i*3+1]=rgb[i*3+2]=image.Pixels[i];
        void Dot(int x,int y,byte r,byte g,byte b,int size=1) {for(int dy=-size;dy&lt;=size;dy++)for(int dx=-size;dx&lt;=size;dx++){int xx=x+dx,yy=y+dy;if((uint)xx&gt;=(uint)w||(uint)yy&gt;=(uint)h)continue;int at=(yy*w+xx)*3;rgb[at]=r;rgb[at+1]=g;rgb[at+2]=b;}}
        if(result.Circle is CircleFit c) {int count=(int)Math.Ceiling(c.Radius*8)+64;for(int i=0;i&lt;count;i++){double a=i*2*Math.PI/count;Dot((int)Math.Round(c.CenterX+c.Radius*Math.Cos(a)),(int)Math.Round(c.CenterY+c.Radius*Math.Sin(a)),255,0,120);}for(int d=-8;d&lt;=8;d++){Dot((int)Math.Round(c.CenterX)+d,(int)Math.Round(c.CenterY),255,0,120);Dot((int)Math.Round(c.CenterX),(int)Math.Round(c.CenterY)+d,255,0,120);}}
        foreach(var p in result.EdgePoints)Dot((int)Math.Round(p.X),(int)Math.Round(p.Y),0,220,80,2);
        using var output=File.Create(path);output.Write(new byte[]{137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10});var header=new byte[13];BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32BigEndian(header,w);BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32BigEndian(header.AsSpan(4),h);header[8]=8;header[9]=2;Chunk(output,&quot;IHDR&quot;,header);
        using var compressed=new MemoryStream();using(var zlib=new ZLibStream(compressed,CompressionLevel.Fastest,leaveOpen:true)){for(int y=0;y&lt;h;y++){zlib.WriteByte(0);zlib.Write(rgb,y*w*3,w*3);}}Chunk(output,&quot;IDAT&quot;,compressed.ToArray());Chunk(output,&quot;IEND&quot;,[]);
    }
    private static void Chunk(Stream output,string name,byte[] data){Span&lt;byte&gt; field=stackalloc byte[4];BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32BigEndian(field,data.Length);output.Write(field);var type=Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(name);output.Write(type);output.Write(data);uint crc=0xffffffff;foreach(byte b in type.Concat(data)){crc^=b;for(int bit=0;bit&lt;8;bit++)crc=(crc&amp;1)!=0?(crc&gt;&gt;1)^0xedb88320:crc&gt;&gt;1;}BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt32BigEndian(field,~crc);output.Write(field);}
}</pre></details></details><details id="U01" class="unknown"><summary>U01 · 已取有限原托管文本链 → 外部WPF测量/native栅格/原机绑定/当前导出仍开放 · unknown</summary><p>本专题取得选定文本路径的具体字段、分支、数值与调用目标；不能把25托管体和一个PInvoke声明计作实际运行闭链或原生等价。未新增产品实现、未执行厂商对象/XAML/对话框/native/设备。</p><p>待核：原机实际程序集/DLL选择、字体/编码与像素、具体工具文本生产者/活动ShapeList，以及当前主WPF导出消费路径仍未知。</p></details><p>主框架实施41/96＝42.71%（32包×3具名单元），专题增量0。文字链的静态分支记录不代表全入口或原生像素等价。</p></html><script data-document-web src="document-web-links.js"></script>
